selection.method: Bilateral middle-finger PIP skin weight-island correction by distal connected component; no pose compensation or smoothing
selection.operation: For the independently assigned middle-finger distal skin component on each side, only nonzero same-side Index Finger1/11/12 joint slots are reassigned to matching Middle Finger2/21/22 slots. Every original WEIGHTS float32 byte, hand influence, same-segment distribution, MCP web, UV, vertex/index geometry, morphs and GLB JSON remains unchanged.
selection.excluded: Rejected nearest-branch and smoothing candidates are not part of this recipe.

mcpContinuity.constraints: Exact unchanged individual Hand/PIP/DIP/non-MCP influence weights; unchanged aggregate MCP root total (float32 rounding). UV bind-weld group consistency; no geometry/UV/normals/material changes. Selected roots share inverse-edge weighted topological neighbor field.
mcpContinuity.operation: Second ordered phase; only same-side non-thumb MCP branch allocation changes; Hand/PIP/DIP per-bone mass remains exact. Entire repaired v1 intermediate is byte-recoverable.
